name: @captureflow/selfhost-admin
description: The admin app of a self-hosted CaptureFlow: workspaces, people and sign-up, served under /admin by the Docker image. Never deployed to Cloudflare.

scripts.selfhost:build: esbuild selfhost/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=selfhost/dist/server.mjs --external:./server.js --log-level=warning "--banner:js=import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
